description: Provision a Google Cloud Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryNamespace via Config Connector. Fields mirror the servicedirectory.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ServiceDirectoryNamespace spec.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the Namespace. A full list of valid locations can be found by running 'gcloud beta service-directory locations list'.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The namespaceId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryNamespace
